_README: One entry per market you've researched. Match by 'title_contains' (case-insensitive substring match against the market title from GET /markets) since exchangeId/marketId are not known until the bot lists markets. 'group' is used for correlation-exposure capping in bot.py -- give correlated markets (same state, same chamber-control theme, same national-environment bucket) the same group name. Leave 'polls' empty if you have none yet; the bot will fall back to 'fundamental_p'/'external_p' only. Update this file whenever you (or Claude, on request) do fresh research on a race -- the bot itself never fetches news.
